component.name: ShiftDex
component.summary: Unpack, edit and repack APK and JAR files

description.p: ShiftDex unpacks Android apps and Java archives, lets you browse and edit what is inside, and packs them again.

ul.li: Edit smali code, resources and manifests with syntax highlighting
Read the same code as Java, decompiled by jadx, and jump between the two
Change an app's name, icon and package name
Snapshots of the whole project and backups of single files
Plugins: share a set of changes and apply it to other apps
White, black and AMOLED themes, configurable keyboard shortcuts

description.p: APK decoding and building is done by APKEditor, which ShiftDex downloads on first run.
